question: Which maharaja of Manipur signed the Instrument of Accession with the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bodhchandra Singh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On 11th August 1947, the Maharaja of Manipur, Bodhachandra Singh, signed the Instrument of Accession with the Government of India.**
 
• Under this agreement,** Manipur became a member of the Constituent Assembly of India** and the power of defense and external affairs and communication for the State was given to India.
 
• The rest of the power was with the state but on the lines of shared sovereignty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuki-Zo and Naga** are the major tribes of the state.
 
• The capital of the state is** Imphal.**
 
• The Chief Minister of the state is **N. Biren Singh and the governor is Najma Heptulla. (May 2020).**
 
• **Keibul Lamjao National Park** is in Manipur.
